english.note: Use 速度 as the all-purpose noun for a general or measurable rate of motion, including the broad idea of moving quickly.

exampleSentences.english: This car's speed is really high.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢架車嘅速度真係好高。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ge3 cuk1 dou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1

english.note: Use 速度 as the all-purpose noun for general speed or velocity.

exampleSentences.english: The pace of the race is too fast for me to keep up with.
exampleSentences.traditional: 比賽嘅速度太快，我跟唔上。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bei2 coi3 ge3 cuk1 dou6 taai3 faai3 ngo5 gan1 m4 soeng5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical speed or the speed at which something changes or progresses.

exampleSentences.english: This machine has a very fast operating rate.
